template.name: Network

transition.label: p : producer_id
net_tx[p]?
packet = outgoing[p], owner = p, x = 0, status[outgoing[p].id] = 1, admitted++

outgoing[p].id = p * PACKETS_PER_PRODUCER + next, outgoing[p].src = p, outgoing[p].dst = 1 - p, outgoing[p].kind = p, outgoing[p].payload = next + 2 * p, expected[outgoing[p].id] = outgoing[p], pending[p] = true, wait = 0

template.name: Receiver
template.declaration: // This stub is always ready. It checks the handover but does no application work.

transition.label: net_rx[id]?

integrityError = integrityError || status[incoming.id] != 1 || incoming.src != expected[incoming.id].src || incoming.dst != expected[incoming.id].dst || incoming.kind != expected[incoming.id].kind || incoming.payload != expected[incoming.id].payload || incoming.dst != id || deliveries[incoming.id] != 0, deliveries[incoming.id]++, status[incoming.id] = 2, delivered++

query.comment: N2: A loss is possible in the chosen loss mode.
N3: Both producers can be waiting while the shared slot is busy.
N4: The receiver sees the admitted fields and no duplicate.
N5: Each test packet is delivered at most once.
N6: Every admitted packet is in flight, delivered or lost.
N7: Delivery bookkeeping matches packet status.

query.formula: A[] ((Link.Delivered || Link.Lost) imply (Link.x >= D_MIN && Link.x <= D_MAX))
query.comment: N8: Each resolution happens within the service interval.
N9: The service clock stays within its upper bound.
N10: An admitted packet eventually leaves the slot.

query.formula: A[] (deadlock imply (Sender0.Done && Sender1.Done && Link.Idle && delivered + lost == N_PACKETS))
query.comment: N11: Deadlocks are only the completed harness.
N12: All packets can be delivered.
N13: All finite test packets eventually resolve.
N14: In bounded mode with K_LOSS=1 neither flow loses both packets.
N15: All packets can be lost in unrestricted mode.

query.formula: A[] forall (i : packet_id) (status[i] == 1 imply (Link.Transmitting && Link.packet.id == i))
query.comment: N16: An outstanding ID identifies the single in-flight packet.
N17: A packet marked lost was not delivered.
N18: Longest observed admission wait for producer 1 in this finite workload.
